<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-03-0217-06-43" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="ii'dod pa'i lan dgag pa"/>
         <milestone unit="section" n="(a) (lo)"/>
         2 pa la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs></note> na re thal ba'i sbyor ba de 2 la tshad mas bsal pa yod pas rang rgyud mi rtag pas stong pa dang du mas stong pa'i phyogs chos 'grub par thal ba 'dod pa yin te 
               <lb n="93b6"/>mi rtag pa dang du ma <choice><reg>dang</reg><orig>‹dang›</orig></choice> tshogs pa khegs pa'i phyir dang de nyid la phyogs <choice><reg>chos</reg><orig>chos</orig></choice> grub par bzhag ste nam mkha' bzhin no || 
         tshogs pa khegs pa yang <choice><reg>yin te</reg><orig>yin te</orig></choice>  chos can de lta bu rang mi srid pa'i phyir dang de la rang rgyud kyi khyab pa yod pas stong pa dang du ma dang 'brel pas stong pa'i bsgrub bya sgrub pa yin te yod pa dang du ma dang 'brel pa'i tshogs pa khegs pa'i phyir nam mkha' bzhin no || de rang ji ltar na 
               <lb n="93b7"/>chos can de lta bu rang mi srid pa'i phyir ro || des na rang bzhin rtags kyi thal 'gyur gyis khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i rang rgyun 'phen par byed do zhes zer ba ni
         <milestone unit="section" n="(b) (dgag pa)"/>
        ma yin te | rtags kyi dngos 'gal dang tshgos pa kehgs pas phyogs chos grub na ha cang thal ba dang | chos kyi dngos 'gal dang thsogs pa khegs pas sgrub bya 'grub na ha cang thal ba'o ||</seg></TEI>
